{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u079/system/state/workspace/programs/task-0d594af8.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Separator lines are the uniform internal rows/columns.
    sep_rows = [r for r in sep_rows if 0 < r < h - 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in sep_cols if 0 < c < w - 1]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        out, start = [], 0
        for cut in cuts:
            if start < cut:
                out.append((start, cut))
            start = cut + 1
        if start < n:
            out.append((start, n))
        return out
    rs, cs = spans(h, sep_rows), spans(w, sep_cols)
    from collections import Counter
    vals = Counter(grid[r][c] for a,b in rs for r in range(a,b) for x,y in cs for c in range(x,y))
    background = vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y)) > 1 else background
             for x,y in cs] for a,b in rs]
"
}
